evals.prompt: Use $codex-literature-workflow to check the PDF reading environment only. Do not search the web, use Zotero, or write Obsidian notes.
evals.expected_output: Environment report with package and CLI availability, plus no Zotero or Obsidian writes.

evals.prompt: Use $codex-literature-workflow to find 2 open-access English papers on edge intelligence for rail transit. Download only legal open PDFs and write a candidate table and manifest. Keep Zotero and Obsidian disabled.
evals.expected_output: Dated candidate table, access-route evidence, verified local PDF records, no browser-auth, no Zotero/Obsidian output.

evals.prompt: Use $codex-literature-workflow on two already-downloaded PDFs with source_input_mode=local-library and download_enabled=false. Ask whether Zotero and Obsidian should be enabled. If Zotero is enabled, prepare validated linked-file scripts for the user to run, then create PDF-first notes with selected visual pages. Do not prepare Markdown-note attachment yet.
evals.expected_output: Local PDFs registered with access_route=local-library, download skipped, controller-mediated dispatches, user-run Zotero script plus verification or honest pending status, Obsidian notes with page evidence, visual status, controller/agent worklogs, and batch report.

evals.prompt: Use $codex-literature-workflow with project_profile=dissertation-strict on one already-downloaded PDF. Do not search the web. First ask whether there is a local direction/mapping document and whether Zotero/Obsidian should be enabled. Initialize controller records and write pending/disabled Zotero statuses honestly.
evals.expected_output: Project profile, controller/agent worklogs, quota status, temp artifact ledger, source manifest, optional Zotero link index with collection/PDF/MD status, Obsidian note frontmatter with zotero_collection and md_note_path, and Waiting review handoff.

evals.prompt: Use $codex-literature-workflow to screen Chinese papers about a topic. Do not download unless open or already authorized. Record CNKI/Wanfang/VIP route details and manual blockers.
evals.expected_output: Candidate table with Chinese database route fields, distinct CNKI/Wanfang/VIP/manual/unavailable access routes, no private credential data, and LiteratureAgent worklog entries.

evals.prompt: Use $codex-literature-workflow to acquire one authorized closed-source paper with download_enabled=true and closed_source_fallback=chrome-then-computer-use-once. Use authenticated Chrome if allowed; if Chrome gets stuck at verification, try Computer Use once, then stop and write the blocker if unresolved.
evals.expected_output: Browser permission recorded, Chrome attempted before Computer Use, at most one Computer Use fallback recorded, unresolved verification marked captcha-blocked or manual-user, no private credential data stored, and any accepted PDF quality-checked.

evals.prompt: Use $codex-literature-workflow to initialize a controller workspace for a mixed literature workflow. Do not search yet. Record the recommended dependency setup, default research companion, auxiliary LR companion, and permanent Python environment recommendation.
evals.expected_output: Controller records include dependency_setup.md; setup recommends installing or enabling relevant companion skills/plugins including academic-research-suite, auxiliary research-lr-ra, zotero:Zotero, zotero-linked-attachments, sciencedirect-live-session-fetcher, Browser/Chrome/Computer Use, pdf, and wiki/Obsidian helpers when the requested workflow needs them; public origin/source URLs are recorded when known, maintainer-built vendored companions are labeled with their companion-skills paths and installer command, and OpenAI plugin-only dependencies are labeled honestly; academic-research-suite is the default research companion for discovery/screening; research-lr-ra is auxiliary/fallback only; environment.yml/requirements.txt and env_check.py are recommended for the permanent codex-literature Python environment; long search/download work is deferred until dependency status and fallbacks are recorded.

evals.prompt: Use $codex-literature-workflow to initialize a long Zotero and Obsidian literature workflow. Use the current task as Controller Console, do not create a persistent goal, create or reuse LiteratureAgent, ZoteroAgent, and ObsidianAgent sessions when available, then stop before discovery.
evals.expected_output: Initialization records identify the current task as Controller Console, record controller_goal_status=not-needed, include a specialist session plan or sequential fallback, session_registry.md, dependency_setup.md, and a first dispatch plan. No long search, download, Zotero, or Obsidian work begins until scope and execution topology are recorded.

evals.prompt: Use $codex-literature-workflow where the user only says they want papers. Before doing any search, ask the required startup scope questions.
evals.expected_output: The controller asks for paper direction, target paper count, source input mode, download/access permission, language scope, Zotero connection, Obsidian connection, local input paths, output/write paths, Zotero/Obsidian/QMD mapping needs, and whether Git checkpoints are enabled. user_scope_confirmed remains false and no LiteratureAgent/ZoteroAgent/ObsidianAgent work is dispatched until answers are recorded.

evals.prompt: Use $codex-literature-workflow to initialize a long mixed literature workflow. Do not search yet. Explicitly enable local Git checkpoints before specialist work.
evals.expected_output: Controller records include git_checkpoint_required=true, git_checkpoint_interval, git_checkpoint_root, git_push_policy=manual-only, and git_checkpoints.md. The controller verifies the target root is a Git repository, stops for user action if it is not, or creates a local checkpoint after initialization/scope/dependency/session records with git status and privacy scan recorded. The controller stages explicit safe paths only, does not use git add ., and never pushes automatically.

evals.prompt: Use $codex-literature-workflow to test Obsidian Wiki ingest with optional QMD in an isolated temp vault. Do not run qmd embed.
evals.expected_output: The workflow creates or verifies manifest-backed Obsidian Wiki files including .manifest.json, source_registry.md, zotero_link_index.md, and one formal note per canonical source; duplicate aliases are report/manifest-only; manual-check sources do not become formal notes; QMD is treated as optional index infrastructure rather than source of truth; qmd update/status/search are attempted only when available and configured; qmd embed/query/vsearch are not run without explicit approval; no real Zotero sqlite, production vault, private PDFs, credentials, or browser cookies are modified.

evals.prompt: Use $codex-literature-workflow only to attach one existing local PDF to an existing Zotero parent item. Do not initialize a broader literature project.
evals.expected_output: The main skill routes this isolated request to $zotero-linked-attachments, asks only for the parent key/file mapping and required Zotero availability, and does not impose the full controller questionnaire, workspace initialization, persistent goal, or Git policy.

evals.prompt: Use $codex-literature-workflow only to inspect one local PDF and report its text/render readiness. Do not create a Zotero or Obsidian workflow.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats this as a bounded PDF/environment check, runs only relevant readiness/probe steps, and does not require full startup scope, specialist sessions, a persistent goal, or Git checkpoints.
